steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Delian League was founded in 478 BC as a defensive alliance against Persia, with Athens as leader (hegemon) | Key Fact: Member states contributed ships or money (phoros/tribute) stored on the island of Delos at the League's treasury | Key Fact: Athens gradually transformed the League into an empire: moved the treasury to Athens (454 BC), forced members to use Athenian coinage and courts | Key Fact: States that tried to leave (e.g. Naxos, Thasos) were forcibly prevented; the League became an instrument of Athenian control

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the athenian empire (delian league), and one past-paper question.
